text:
deploybot: Canary failed for hotfix image rbld/inference:20260323-hotfix in eu-west1 (503s on embeddings path). Marking rollout PAUSED and requesting manual approval for expedited pin or rollback. Logs: https://internal.logs/ingest/1719627777 :warning:

elaine: Seen the alert. Is this the kv-cache leak we saw in staging?

mike: yes, reproduces on a small traffic slice in staging. Looks like rare OOM in the quantized path.

sam: @sre-oncall can you grab metrics? Need tail latency and error-rate delta for last 15m.

sre-oncall: Looking now. 15m error increase +2.3% service-wide in eu-west1, though p95 latency only up ~20ms. We've isolated to embed shard 4.

dana: If it's shard 4 we could pin traffic away from eu-west1 for now and push hotfix to remaining regions. Options: 1) rollback to previous image 2) approve manual pin (force rollout) 3) partial rollback of eu-west1. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

elaine: Need to decide fast — product is seeing fallback behavior. My vote: partial rollback of eu-west1 and continue canaries in other regions.

mike: Agree. Also prepping a micro-patch that drops quantization kernel for that shard. ETA ~30m.

sam: If we partial rollback, we should update release notes & change window so support knows what to tell customers. I'll draft a short note.

sre-oncall: Executing traffic-shift playbook now. Running command: ```
# move embed traffic off eu-west1
rbctl traffic shift --service=embeddings --from=eu-west1 --to=global-fallback --percentage=100 --dry-run=false
```

deploybot: Action logged by deploybot: traffic-shift started by sre-oncall at 2026-03-23T03:21:45Z. Canary paused.

dana: @mike when you have the patch, we can canary it to eu-west1 smaller slice (5%) after we've validated telemetry for 10m.

mike: patch pushed to rbld/inference:20260323-hotfix.2, tagging ops. Will request a small canary now.

elaine: Approving limited canary to eu-west1 at 5% once we confirm no 5xxs for 10m. @sre-oncall please confirm rollback criteria: if errors >0.5% above baseline for 10m -> immediate rollback.

sre-oncall: Confirmed. I'll keep an eye and set an alert.

sam: Draft release note snippet: "Hotfix: temporary rollback and targeted kernel patch deployed to address rare embeddings OOM in eu-west1. No customer action required; we're monitoring." Will attach link once posted.

deploybot: Manual pin request detected: ```
# pin image to rollout for expedited hotfix
deploybot pin --image=rbld/inference:20260323-hotfix.2 --scope=eu-west1 --percentage=5 --reason="targeted kernel patch for embed shard 4"
```

dana: +1 from me for the 5% canary.

mike: initiating canary now.

sre-oncall: Monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards/internal/embeds-eu-west1. Alert thresholds set.

elaine: Good coordination. Once 30m passes clean, we'll increase to 50% then to 100% with standard cadence. If anything spikes we abort and roll back to rbld/inference:20260320-stable.

sam: Release note posted: https://confluence.company/hotfix/20260323-embed-kernel-patch (short summary + rollback rationale).

deploybot: Canary steady at 5% for 12m. No new 5xxs. Awaiting 18 more minutes to reach 30m window.

dana: tagging support and product for FYI: @support-team @product.

elaine: Thanks team — keep updates brief here. If we hit threshold, call paging policy.

mike: will report at 30m mark.

sre-oncall: 30m reached, metrics green. Proceeding to 50% ramp now via deploybot.

deploybot: Traffic ramp started: 5% -> 50% in eu-west1. Next check in 15m.
